home.nothingDue: Today's review is done. See you tomorrow.
home.guestBody: You can start learning without signing in — your progress is kept on this phone.
home.cardHint: Tap the card to turn it
home.greetingNote: "Ahlan wa sahlan", the old Arabic greeting, meaning: "you have arrived among your own family, and may your path be easy."
home.headline: <brand>Mufradat</brand> is the straightforward way for Bengali speakers to learn Arabic vocabulary.
home.decksBody: Each deck is its own world — the words of the Quran, the words of the market, the names for family. Start with whichever you need.
home.closingHeading: Give it ten minutes today. Tomorrow the verse reads a little further.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.body: Sign in with Google and your progress stays the same on every device.
auth.guestTitle: Want to learn without an account?
auth.guestBody: As a guest your progress is kept on this phone. Sign in later and all of it moves into your account — nothing is lost.
auth.failed: Couldn't sign you in. Try again.
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not configured on this server. Everything still works as a guest — your progress is kept on this device.

migration.title: Moving your progress into your account
migration.body: Sending {count, number} items saved on this phone. Keep the app open.
migration.doneTitle: Your progress is in your account
migration.doneBody: {cards, number} words and {reviews, number} reviews moved across.
migration.failedBody: Nothing is lost — it's all still on this phone. Try again.

words.title: Words
words.searchPlaceholder: Search in Arabic, Bengali or English
words.emptyBody: Try Arabic without vowel marks, the Bengali meaning, or the English one.

word.needsReview: An editor has not yet checked the Bengali meaning of this word.
word.noExamples: No examples for this word yet.
word.noRootFamily: No other words on this root yet.
word.notesPrompt: Writing a word down in your own words is what makes it stick.

review.saveFailed: Couldn't send that answer. It's saved on this phone and will sync when you reconnect.
review.doneBody: You saw {count, number} words today. See you tomorrow.
review.nothingDueBody: You've finished today's words. Raise your daily limit if you want more.
review.shortcutHint: 1–4 to grade · space to flip · ? for all shortcuts

games.title: Games
games.intro: Each game runs for about a minute and is built from the words you're due today — so playing counts as studying.
games.matchPairsShort: Match each Arabic word to its Bengali meaning
games.multipleChoiceShort: Choose the right meaning from four
games.listeningShort: Hear it, then pick the word
games.streakRushShort: As many as you can before time runs out
games.roundSummary: Score {score, number} · right first time {correct, number}/{total, number}
games.countsAsStudy: These answers counted towards today's review.
games.saveFailed: Couldn't send that answer. It's saved on this phone.
games.notEnoughWordsTitle: Not enough words for a game yet
games.notEnoughWordsBody: Learn a few words first and the games open up.

matchPairsGame.howTo: Tap an Arabic word, then its Bengali meaning. Matched pairs drop out of the board.

multipleChoiceGame.howTo: Read the Arabic word and pick the right meaning from four. A wrong tap lets you try again.

spellingGame.howTo: Read the Bengali meaning and write the Arabic word. Full marks with the vowel marks; right consonants still count.
spellingGame.guideIntro: Type in Latin letters and they turn into Arabic: kitaab gives كتاب.

harakatGame.howTo: The word appears without its vowel marks. Tap a letter, then choose its mark. Letters that carry nothing get “no mark”.
harakatGame.hint: Tap a letter, then place its mark
harakatGame.wrongCount: {count, number} letters don't match — have another look at those

streakRushGame.howTo: Sixty seconds, three options, no second chances. Keep a run going and each answer is worth more than the last.

notes.title: Notes
notes.bodyPlaceholder: Write here. Arabic, Bengali and English can sit in the same note.
notes.pickOrCreate: Pick a note on the left, or write a new one.
notes.emptyBody: Start with the word that keeps slipping away from you.
notes.noMatchesBody: Try different words, or clear the tag filter.
notes.saveFailed: That didn't save. Your text is still here and we'll try again.

progress.forecastTotal: {count, number} due over the next 14 days
progress.masteryHint: A word counts as mature once it comes back after three weeks or more.
progress.retentionHint: Last {days, number} days, counting only words you had already learned.
progress.retentionEmpty: No learned word has come back round yet, so there is nothing to measure.
progress.emptyBody: Finish one session and your year starts filling in here.
